title: smtp: unify routing — all email through Sieve, fileinto newsgroup
description: Currently SMTP has two paths: inline Sieve (non-list mail with users configured) and queue/List-ID routing. Unify to one path: all SMTP-received email goes through Sieve. Sieve can fileinto a newsgroup via 'newsgroup:' prefix (triggers NNTP injection inline). Implicit keep / unhandled mail goes to configurable catch-all folder (default: 'unsorted'). Remove list_routing config and route_message queue drain entirely.
design: fileinto 'newsgroup:comp.lang.rust' -> call nntp_client::post_article inline during DATA phase. Remove use_sieve gate in session.rs. Remove list_routing from Config. Remove route_message from main.rs. Change Keep action default folder from INBOX to configurable catch-all (default 'unsorted').
